sentences.en: The cost of financing of the project was very high.
sentences.zh: 该项目的融资成本非常高。

sentences.en: It is necessary to secure financing for local road maintenance.
sentences.zh: 有必要为当地道路维护筹集资金。

sentences.en: There's no chance of him financing his electoral campaign.
sentences.zh: 他没有机会为其竞选活动提供资金。

senses.zh: 筹措资金,理财,筹集资金,融资v.为…供给资金，从事金融活动( finance的现在分词 )
